description: Scores all 9 gemstones 0-100 for this exact chart (functional benefic, Shadbala, dignity, afflictions) with a should-you-wear verdict and reason, plus the lagna-lord life stone. Covers Neelam, Pukhraj, Panna, Manik, Moti, Moonga, Heera, Gomed, Cat's Eye. Trikaal Vaani sells no gemstones.

latitude.description: Birthplace latitude in decimal degrees (e.g. New Delhi 28.6139)

longitude.description: Birthplace longitude in decimal degrees (e.g. New Delhi 77.2090)

stone.description: Optional: only this stone, e.g. "Neelam" or "Blue Sapphire"

time.description: Time of birth, 24-hour HH:MM (local time at birthplace). 12:00 is the conventional value when the exact time is unknown.

timezone.description: UTC offset in hours at birth (India = 5.5)

name: gemstone_check
title: Gemstone (Ratna) suitability
